cases.story: Vocabulary v1 plus two project rules validates and checks; the cycle breaks only the owned ring.
Editing any included definition, role or included base constraint refuses; own elements/attachments remain editable.
A re-pin alone loses the fact type used by the project ring. It produces only a reviewable analysis, not a staged invalid candidate.
One proposal re-pins and moves the same ring to the replacement relation. The owner reviews its distinct radius; only the authored project model publishes.
The flattened candidate is a valid standalone model, but is not the authored replay of these operations.
The old versioned vocabulary is gone or overwritten. Only an explicit snapshot with its original exact digest supplies historical bytes.

Unknown/duplicate/empty/over-eight old bindings refuse before snapshot IO. Existing symlink/nonregular/escaping paths and original-suffix parse violations refuse; a differently suffixed backup filename cannot select a new parser.
Snapshot identity/order/declaration/content tampering refuses; an unchanged other include never gets historical substitution.

Included ownership wins over operations gate. An independently decisive operation gate precedes candidate IO; a repin-dependent operation is gated before own semantic validation. Unrelated operations remain usable.
Change the new vocabulary after preview, at the final verification seam before CAS, or before an already-live retry. No unchanged includer hash grants currency.
Apply can be interrupted after publishing the includer. Finalize authenticates old history, requires current new bytes, and can recover after restoration.
Linked conformance is not enabled for includes. Preview/forged apply/finalization must not bypass that refusal; include-free linked behavior stays frozen.
A serialized include preview must fit the existing claim cap in canonical and actual CLI forms. A legal-loader oversized bundle refuses before writing or staging.

Discover and every ILP preparation/mined/candidate intake use the rooted composition for semantics and the authored model for output. Generated proposals contain own additions, not copied vocabulary definitions.
Old schema1/2 proposal/preview/record readers reject the new kind/locator/host/snapshot fields before their execution gate. Include-free wire bytes omit both snapshot fields.
Full-range include IDs remain unstripped and JSON-quoted, while malformed arbitrary shapes never traceback. New ownership/dependency work is measured as a separate layer.
